description: This C# source file defines the StorageFaultGrain class within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace. The class implements an IStorageFaultGrain interface and provides functionality to simulate storage faults (read, write, clear) for testing Orleans grains. It tracks faults using dictionaries and can throw exceptions when certain storage operations are invoked, useful for testing error handling scenarios.

classes.name: StorageFaultGrain
classes.description: A grain class that tracks and injects storage exceptions for testing purposes, implementing the IStorageFaultGrain interface.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain, sets up the logger, and prepares the fault dictionaries.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Registers an exception to be thrown on read operations for a specified grain ID.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Registers an exception to be thrown on write operations for a specified grain ID.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Registers an exception to be thrown on clear operations for a specified grain ID.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Simulates a read fault by throwing the registered exception for a specified grain ID.

methods.description: Simulates a write fault by throwing the registered exception for a specified grain ID.

methods.description: Simulates a clear fault by throwing the registered exception for a specified grain ID.
